definitions.gloss: honorarium; reward; compensation; fee for services
definitions.explanation: Money or a gift given as thanks for a service, favor, or assistance. More formal and gracious than a simple payment, it acknowledges the recipient's effort or expertise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{謝礼|しゃれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: I received an honorarium for the lecture.

examples.japanese: ⟦アンケート→アンケート：03829_ankeeto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{謝礼|しゃれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{渡|わた}し→渡す：02442_watasu⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will give a reward to those who cooperate with the survey.

examples.japanese: {謝礼|しゃれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{異|こと}なります→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ご{確認|かくにん}→ご確認：23544_gokakunin⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The amount of the honorarium varies depending on the nature of the work, so please confirm in advance.

notes:
USAGE:
{謝礼|しゃれい} implies gratitude rather than a contractual obligation. It is often used for one-time services such as lectures, consultations, survey participation, and expert advice.
Unlike ⟦{報酬|ほうしゅう}→報酬：12094_houshuu⟧ (remuneration), which implies a formal payment for professional work, {謝礼|しゃれい} carries a stronger sense of personal gratitude and is often a token of appreciation rather than full market-rate compensation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {謝礼|しゃれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧ / ⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧ (to pay an honorarium)
- {謝礼|しゃれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧ (to receive an honorarium)
- ⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧{謝礼|しゃれい} (lecture honorarium)
- {謝礼|しゃれい}{金|きん} (monetary reward)
